features.name: any_comment_quotes_or_references_op_text
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment explicitly quote or reference a specific textual element of the original post (title or argument)?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than OP). Output 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes OP wording (title or argument) or explicitly refers to a specific identifiable statement, claim, phrase or passage of the OP's text (e.g., 'you say that...', 'your point about X'), verified against title and argument. Output 0 if no comment does (generic replies, or only general topic discussion, do not count). Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates and reports of the outcome as evidence. Empty comment list: 0. Missing/malformed OC_comments: null.

h0: any_comment_quotes_or_references_op_text has no association with the probability of OP view change.
h1: Discussions with any_comment_quotes_or_references_op_text = 1 have a higher probability of OP view change.
note: Presence measured (unspecified quantity). Outcome is binary delta; OLS gives a linear probability model. Comments are current text with unknown timing; comments or OP text may contain outcome announcements, which the prompt ignores. Association only, not causal.
